description: Install, share, sync, and create AI agent skills across coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Pi) using the agr CLI. Use whenever the user mentions agr, agr.toml, agr.lock, agrx, or asks to: add a skill ("install the pdf skill", "agr add ..."), sync agent resources across tools, share skills with their team, scaffold a new SKILL.md, run a skill ephemerally (agrx), set up a repo to manage AI agent dependencies, or configure tools/sources/instruction-syncing. Also use whenever an agr.toml or agr.lock is present in the project and the user is doing resource-management work.
